g.text: DRAFT / NOT FOR ORDER / NO POWER / NO FIRE - hierarchy INTEGRATED in root SCH; PCB/firmware NOT synchronized

g.desc: DRAFT / NOT FOR ORDER / NO POWER / NO FIRE - hierarchy INTEGRATED in root SCH; PCB/firmware NOT synchronized

g.text: SIROKKO: MINIMAL SAFETY CORE - 3 IC + EXISTING RELAY DRIVER

g.desc: SIROKKO: MINIMAL SAFETY CORE - 3 IC + EXISTING RELAY DRIVER

g.text: Process checks, timings, purge and software fault handling belong to ESP32; motor/purge power path is unchanged.

g.desc: Process checks, timings, purge and software fault handling belong to ESP32; motor/purge power path is unchanged.

g.text: CLEAR_N = WD_OK & THERMAL_OK & RELAY_DRIVER_OK & RESET_RELEASED & P24_PRESENT & MCU_PERMIT

g.desc: CLEAR_N = WD_OK & THERMAL_OK & RELAY_DRIVER_OK & RESET_RELEASED & P24_PRESENT & MCU_PERMIT

g.text: Positive ARM edge latches permission. Any CLEAR_N=0 removes permission; no automatic rearm.

g.desc: Positive ARM edge latches permission. Any CLEAR_N=0 removes permission; no automatic rearm.

g.text: 24V loss/recovery, startup dynamics, relay ratings and full safety acceptance remain OPEN.

g.desc: 24V loss/recovery, startup dynamics, relay ratings and full safety acceptance remain OPEN.

g.text: TPS3431 fixed WDT: 170..230ms; heartbeat falling-edge interval <=100ms. No peripheral-task heartbeat.

g.desc: TPS3431 fixed WDT: 170..230ms; heartbeat falling-edge interval <=100ms. No peripheral-task heartbeat.

g.text: Ports: RESET NC -> 3V3; ARM_PULSE=GPIO41; MCU_PERMIT=GPIO21; P24_PRESENT=GPIO6 INPUT ONLY.

g.desc: Ports: RESET NC -> 3V3; ARM_PULSE=GPIO41; MCU_PERMIT=GPIO21; P24_PRESENT=GPIO6 INPUT ONLY.

g.text: Q -> safety relay IN3; /Q -> DRV8803 nENBL(8). GLOW_CMD and FUEL_CMD stay separate.

g.desc: Q -> safety relay IN3; /Q -> DRV8803 nENBL(8). GLOW_CMD and FUEL_CMD stay separate.
